init_custom_ar: initialize custom all-reduce with IPC tensors, rank data, rank, and full NVLink flag
all_reduce: perform custom all-reduce operation on input tensor producing output tensor with registered buffer
dispose: dispose of custom all-reduce handle and free associated resources
qr_all_reduce: perform quantized quick all-reduce with configurable quantization level and BF16 cast on ROCm
mscclpp_allreduce: execute MSCCL++ all-reduce on CUDA with context, scratch buffer, and thread/block configuration
